ownership: isolated proposals and reports only; primary retains active sources, functions.tsv, layout.tsv, stage sync, builds, manifests, receipts, Ghidra, HANDOFF.md
selection: round-17 picker with ATTEMPTED harvested mechanically from every round-*/claim.json (612 addresses, rounds 1-17), primary's live claim re-read at run time, and the proven-unreachable classes excluded (jalr through a loaded entry; bodies with no sd ra). Framed, no-branch, sd ra-bearing only. 5512 registered rows, 11383 layout ranges, 11398 pseudocode records, 943 candidates; top 16 by (size, shape).
compiler_use: probe_fm_source.py only; no shared stage writes, no flag changes, no executable byte patching
verification_method: per-range sha256 of the bytes read from the original ELF, compared against start/end/size in /root/kh2fm-build/layout.tsv, plus a pinned ee-objdump disassembly of each range
intake: round-18/r18_dump_orig.py --disasm writes r18_ranges.txt, r18_range_hashes.txt, r18_orig_disasm.txt and <addr>.orig.hex

round18_result.summary: 8 of 16 claimed ranges recovered byte-exact; 8 unresolved with measured blockers.

002db8e8.mechanism: round-17 vtable-setter recipe: *(u32*)param_1 = (u32)(long)&PTR_x; func_A((u32)(long)((u8*)param_1 + off)); func_B(param_1); asm volatile ("");

001b5c78.mechanism: two calls on one derived pointer, result read before them: uVar1=param_1+104; uVar2=*(u32*)(uVar1+44); func_001d2180(uVar1); func_001d20a8(uVar1); return uVar2;

002e2dd8.mechanism: __builtin_expect(puVar1 != 0, 1) reproduces the beqzl likely branch and the ld ra / ld s0 restore order

001aa940.mechanism: six arguments read off the register shuffle ($4..$9), plus a trailing asm volatile ("") to stop GCC rewriting the single call into a tail call

compiler_level_findings: $v0-vs-$t7 scratch choice for a global address or a 16-byte move: ~7 instances (00308cd0 r7, 0030a2d0 r11, 0030a690 and 0018d808 r14, 0030df00 r15, 00307fe0 r15, 00181a90 r18).
A body load's address-materialising lui is never issued in the prologue region (round 14, eight members).
Epilogue ld ra scheduled into the middle of the body (001ac700, 002ef340, 0018d808).
Leaf frame-pointer idiom sd s8 / move s8,sp / ... / move sp,s8 / ld s8 (002b99a0, 002b6ab8, 002b81ec, 002b8214) implies -fno-omit-frame-pointer for some original translation units.
jalr $v0 vtable dispatch: nine members, parked.
Prologue sink of a vtable-pointer store to the incoming parameter (0028b7f8 r15, 00315678/00315700/00316890 r16).
Register pins (register ... asm("$t7")) are rejected outright by this compiler, so none of these are reachable from C.
round18_result.positive_finding: Register moves involving $8..$15 in a body or in a jal delay slot encode the callee's argument count, not impossible register usage. Reading them literally as an argument list recovered three targets previously parked as 'not expressible in C': 00158050 (round 14), 002ba3b8 (round 9) and 001aa940 (this round).
